mapper.select: SELECT c.course_no AS courseNo , c.course_name AS courseName , c.course_year AS courseYear , c.course_semester AS courseSemester , c.course_score AS courseScore , c.course_capacity AS courseCapacity , c.course_description AS courseDescription , c.course_classroom AS classroom , u.user_name AS professorName , d.dept_name AS deptName FROM tb_course c LEFT JOIN tb_sysuser u ON u.user_no = c.professor_user_no LEFT JOIN tb_dept d ON d.dept_code = c.dept_code WHERE c.course_no = #{courseNo}

SELECT course_time_no AS courseTimeNo , course_time_yoil AS courseTimeYoil , course_time_start AS courseTimeStart , course_time_end AS courseTimeEnd FROM tb_course_time WHERE course_no = #{courseNo} ORDER BY course_time_yoil, course_time_start
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollment WHERE course_no = #{courseNo} AND enrollment_status = 0
